source_metadata.title: Epidemiology and risk factors for infection in multiple myeloma patients treated with bispecific antibodies
source_metadata.study_center: University Hospital 12 de Octubre, Madrid, Spain

extraction_limitations: The primary PDF refers to Supplementary Methods, Figure S1, and Tables S1-S9, but no separate supplementary file was present in the specified source folder.
Main-text statements that summarize supplementary analyses were extracted when directly reported in the primary PDF; unavailable supplementary-only details were not reconstructed.

The paper reports 81 (85.3%) courses with on-treatment hypogammaglobulinemia, implying a denominator smaller than 98; the table does not explicitly state the denominator in that row, so the atom preserves the reported count and percentage without inventing a denominator.
No attempt was made to infer unreported vaccination status, cytopenia duration, or individual-agent causal effects.
